type Nested<T> = T extends {
  a: (cb: (value: infer U) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (value: infer U) => void) => void;
} ? U : never;
type NestedObject = Nested<{
  a: (cb: (value: { name: string }) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (value: { size: number }) => void) => void;
}>;
const value: Nested<{
  a: (cb: (value: string) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (value: number) => void) => void;
}> = 'ok';
const named: NestedObject = { name: 'chapter' };

type NestedRest<T> = T extends {
  a: (cb: (...args: infer P) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (...args: infer P) => void) => void;
} ? P : never;
const rest: NestedRest<{
  a: (cb: (value: string) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (value: number, count: number) => void) => void;
}> = [12, 4];
type NestedThis<T> = T extends {
  a: (cb: (this: infer U) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (this: infer U) => void) => void;
} ? U : never;
const receiver: NestedThis<{
  a: (cb: (this: { a: string }) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (this: { b: number }) => void) => void;
}> = { b: 7 };

type Method<T> = T extends { a(x: infer U): void; b(x: infer U): void } ? U : never;
const method: Method<{ a(value: string): void; b(value: number): void }> = 'method';
type MethodCallback<T> = T extends {
  a(cb: () => infer U): void;
  b(cb: () => infer U): void;
} ? U : never;
const methodCallback: MethodCallback<{ a(cb: () => string): void; b(cb: () => number): void }> = 'method callback';
console.log(value, named.name, rest, receiver.b, method, methodCallback);
